meta.name: Goals E2E Test Plan
meta.description: 49 tests covering the Goals feature across /goals, /goals/following, /goals/archived, /goals/status-updates, plus the /goals/[id] detail view reached from /goals.

tests.title: Load the goals directory and display the goal count
tests.assertion: A 'N goal(s)' count label is visible and N > 0

tests.title: All goals tab is active by default
tests.assertion: The 'All goals' tab has an active/selected style (aria-selected=true or active class)

tests.title: Switch to 'My goals' tab filters the list
tests.assertion: Active tab is 'My goals' and list count updates (<= original count)

tests.title: 'More views' dropdown shows Following / Off track / At risk
tests.assertion: Menu shows options 'Following', 'Off track', 'At risk'

tests.title: Search goals by name substring
steps: Type a known substring (e.g., 'goal') into search input
tests.assertion: Every visible row name contains the substring (case-insensitive) and count reflects fewer rows

tests.title: Clearing search restores full list
tests.assertion: List count returns to original baseline

tests.title: Add Status filter narrows the list
tests.assertion: A Status filter chip is visible and list count decreases or unchanged (never increases)

tests.title: Add Owner filter narrows the list
tests.assertion: An Owner filter chip is visible and the visible rows' owner cell matches the chip

tests.title: Reset clears all active filter chips
tests.assertion: No filter chips remain and list count returns to baseline

tests.title: Sort dropdown exposes the documented options
tests.assertion: Menu shows Name, Status, Target date, Following, Last updated, Follower count

tests.title: Toggling sort direction reverses visible order
tests.assertion: First row name differs from the original first row name

tests.title: Columns popover can toggle a column off and on
tests.assertion: The Tags column header disappears, then reappears

tests.title: Name column is locked in Columns popover
tests.assertion: The 'Name' entry has a lock indicator or is disabled (cannot be toggled off)

tests.title: View mode toggle switches from List to Timeline
tests.assertion: Timeline-only controls appear (date-range picker and/or 'View by' dropdown)

tests.title: 'Create goal' button opens the creation dialog
tests.assertion: A dialog with a Name input and a Create submit button is visible

tests.title: Create a new goal with a unique name and see it in the list
tests.assertion: Dialog closes; new goal name is visible in the list after refresh/re-render

tests.title: Create goal with empty name blocks submission
tests.assertion: Submit button is disabled OR a validation error is visible; dialog remains open

tests.title: Create view dialog disables Create with empty name
tests.assertion: Dialog opens and the 'Create' button is disabled while name is empty

tests.title: Clicking a goal row navigates to /goals/[id]
tests.assertion: URL matches /goals/<non-empty-id>

tests.title: Detail view header shows goal name + status badge
tests.assertion: Heading text is non-empty and a status badge is visible in the header

tests.title: Detail sidebar shows Owner, Team, Target date, Progress
tests.assertion: Labels 'Status', 'Progress', 'Owner', 'Team', 'Target date' are all visible in the sidebar

tests.title: Follow button toggles to Following on first click
tests.assertion: Button label changes to 'Following' (or its aria-pressed becomes true)

tests.title: Following page loads with the correct title
tests.assertion: Page heading reads 'Following'

tests.title: All visible rows represent followed goals
tests.assertion: List count > 0 AND every row's 'Following' indicator shows followed state (not '—')

tests.title: Search filters the following list
tests.assertion: Count label shrinks to a number consistent with matching rows

tests.title: Switching 'Following' filter to 'Not following' flips the list
tests.assertion: Visible rows no longer match the original following set (or count changes)

tests.title: Clearing the Following filter restores default view
tests.assertion: List returns to the default following set

tests.title: Add filter menu exposes all filter types
tests.assertion: Menu lists Tag, Status, Owner, Team, Starred, Metric, Reporting line

tests.title: Columns popover toggles a column on /goals/following
tests.assertion: 'Last updated' column header is no longer rendered

tests.title: Sort by following dropdown changes sort label
tests.assertion: Sort label updates to the newly selected option

tests.title: View mode toggle offers List and Card
tests.assertion: Two view-mode buttons are visible; one corresponds to list, one to card layout

tests.title: 'Create goal' action opens the create modal
tests.assertion: Create goal dialog becomes visible with a Name input

tests.title: Archived page loads with title 'Archived'
tests.assertion: Page heading reads 'Archived'

tests.title: Rows show an ARCHIVED badge alongside a status badge
tests.assertion: At least one row renders an 'ARCHIVED' label/badge and a status label

tests.title: Search narrows the archived list
steps: Type part of a goal name
tests.assertion: All visible rows contain the search substring (case-insensitive)

tests.title: Row hover reveals Restore and Delete actions
tests.assertion: 'Restore' and 'Delete' buttons become visible

tests.title: Delete opens a confirmation dialog with the correct title
tests.assertion: Dialog title reads 'Delete goal permanently?' and a 'Delete permanently' button is visible

tests.title: Cancel closes the delete dialog without removing the row
tests.assertion: Dialog closes and the row is still present in the list

tests.title: Confirming delete removes the row and shows a toast
steps: Open Delete dialog on a specific row
tests.assertion: Row is removed from list and a toast message is visible

tests.title: Empty state shows when search matches nothing
tests.assertion: Empty-state copy 'We couldn't find any goals matching your search.' is visible

tests.title: Status updates page loads with title
tests.assertion: Heading reads 'Status updates'

tests.title: Month navigation prev/next updates the displayed month
tests.assertion: Month label changes to a different month

tests.title: 'Catch up' button opens the celebratory overlay
tests.assertion: Catch-up overlay becomes visible (full-screen modal / checkmark animation)

tests.title: 'Write updates' button opens the compose overlay
tests.assertion: Compose overlay appears with a textarea for update body

tests.title: Cancel on compose overlay closes it without posting
tests.assertion: Overlay closes; updates feed unchanged in length

tests.title: Publishing an update appends to the feed and shows a toast
tests.assertion: A toast 'Update published' appears and the new body text is visible in the feed

tests.title: Status summary grid shows all six categories
tests.assertion: Six labels visible: 'On track', 'At risk', 'Off track', 'No update', 'Cancelled', 'Completed'

tests.title: Right sidebar shows Your goals / New goals / Completed goals sections
tests.assertion: Section headings 'Your goals', 'New goals', 'Completed goals' are all visible

tests.title: Empty state appears for a month with no updates
steps: Click prev-month until a month with no updates is reached (cap at 12 attempts)
tests.assertion: 'No updates for <MONTH>' empty-state is visible
